bb.name: Hacks
bb.description: Local patches to bb's own UI, each one standing in for a fix that has not landed upstream yet. Currently: remembers the changes panel's stacked/split view mode and line-wrap toggle across reloads, remembers each thread's range (such as Uncommitted changes) when you switch away and back, opens the unread files bb folds away in a large diff, adds a button to each sidebar project that opens its checkout in your editor, and starts diff code blocks in chat wrapped.
